future_publication_model.fitted_object: V35 route/kind Gaussian error at an already received endpoint forecast; 334 training records on October 1-2.
future_publication_model.validated_object: V35 current-history endpoint/onboard predictions; V36 two physical departure/arrival joint events. Neither validates future publication times, message contents/revisions or their joint history-dependent likelihood.
future_publication_model.code_contract: freeze_snapshot removes future frames; V41 evaluate returns future_messages=0.
future_publication_model.admission: Direction B prerequisites are not yet established. Timing opportunities alone do not admit a future-message algorithm study; this is not evidence of impossibility.

timing_opportunities.interpretation: Availability before the next saved ideal event action, not a measured door deadline. Receipt counts include refreshes with unchanged forecast values and original-root-menu messages that may no longer affect the remaining route. This census establishes temporal opportunity only, not decision value.
timing_opportunities.scope: All 72 frozen V40 cheap_frontier__combined_rolling paths; adjacent decisions only, excluding initial accumulated history and the terminal arrival. Descriptive reuse, no new MC or control.
